subject: new options for export image: pdf & svg

messages.author: aba808a7b471253f
messages.subject: new options for export image: pdf & svg
parts:
Jan added two new export options to CytoscapeRPC -- PDF and SVG. Robert Flight requested them, saying that these formats make for very nice publication-quality images. Previously, the bit-mapped format PNG was all we had. I took a quick look at the results of Jan's changes, and the results are beautiful.

I write for a few reasons:

1) To see if I can persuade :} Jan to add these new options to the existing CyRPC method 'exportView'
2) To explain how these methods will appear in the RCytoscape API (even if Jan finds my argument unpersuasive)
3) To explain how these methods can be called right now as long as you install Jan's latest plugin

------ First, I try to make a case for extending the existing CyRPC method.

We already have the 'saveImage' method:

setMethod ('saveImage', 'CytoscapeWindowClass',
function (obj, file.name, image.type, scale) {
id = as.character (o...@window.id)
result = xml.rpc (obj@uri, 'Cytoscape.exportView', id, file.name, image.type, scale)
invisible (result)
})

called like this

saveImage (cw, 'xxx.png', 'png', scale=2.0)

Jan added Cytoscape.exportViewToPDF and Cytoscape.exportViewToSVG

I propose that the CyRPC API would be a little simpler if we stuck to only Cytoscape.exportView, but expanded it so that it could accept the two new image.type values: pdf & svg. The 'scale' argument would be ignored with the two new image.type values.

---- Second, the upcoming small change to the RCy api, not dependent upon what Jan decides (I can accomodate whatever he chooses):

saveImage (cw, file.name, image.type='png'|'svg'|'pdf', scale=1.0) # 'scale' will be ignored unless image.type is 'png'.

---- Third, here is how to call these methods right now via xml.rpc, directly, as long as you have Jan's latest version of the plugin, available today):

Once you have a CytoscapeWindow object, for example:

cw <- demoSimpleGraph () # makes a 3-node, 3-edge network

Call these lower-level methods to do the export:

xml.rpc (cw@uri, 'Cytoscape.exportViewToPDF', c...@window.id, paste (getwd(), 'test.pdf', sep='/'))
xml.rpc (cw@uri, 'Cytoscape.exportViewToSVG', c...@window.id, paste (getwd(), 'test.svg', sep='/'))


Let me know if any of this needs clarification. After I hear Jan's decision, I will reimplement RCy's "saveImage" method to handle the two new types.

- Paul


On Dec 19, 2011, at 12:37 AM, Jan Bot wrote:

> Hi Paul,
>
> I got a request from Robert Flight to implement network exports to both SVG and PDF. I've implemented those in the new version and I wondered if you could add these functions to RCytoscape.
>
> Cheers,
>
> Jan

messages.author: 12f96a26b5858610
messages.subject: Re: new options for export image: pdf & svg
parts:
Hi Paul,

my first idea was to add the SVG / PDF export functionality to the
exportView funtion. I decided against it because makes no sense to have
a 'scale' parameter for exporting a vector based image.

I could provide an additional exportView function which does not require
the scale parameter but that would mean that the two resulting functions
don't actually do the same. I would prefer fixing it your way but don't
see how it can be done neatly :)

Any suggestions are welcome.

Cheers,

Jan
